verses.1: And they came forward: the daughters of Zelphachad, son of Hefer; the daughters of Gilad, son of Makir; the daughters of Manasseh, son of Moses. They were daughters of Manasseh, son of Joseph. Their names were Machla Na’ah, Haggala, and Tirza.
verses.2: And they stood before Moses, before Aaron, the priest, and before all the leaders. Then the assembly opened the tabernacle according to the commandment.
verses.3: Our father died in the desert. He wasn’t among those who were gathered together to worship God. He died because of his sins. His children didn’t have any descendants after him.
verses.4: Why should the name of our father be removed from among his family? He has no sons to inherit it from us. It should remain with our father’s brothers.
verses.5: And Moses brought his judgment before Jehovah.
verses.6: And the LORD said to Moses, “…”
verses.7: And the daughters of Zelphachad gave them a share in the inheritance within their father’s land. You also transferred their inheritance from their ancestors to them.
verses.8: And to the children of Israel, I will say, “Each man shall die; he will have no son. Then they shall pass over their inheritance to their daughters.”
verses.9: And if he has no daughter, then give his inheritance to his brothers.
verses.10: And if he has no brothers, then give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
verses.11: And if his father has no brothers, and they give his inheritance to someone who is close to him from among his family, then that person shall inherit it. And those descendants of Israel shall follow the laws that Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.12: And the LORD said to Moses, “Go up onto this mountain, and see the land that I have given to the Israelites.”
verses.13: And when you saw her, you too will be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron was gathered to his people.
verses.14: When they married in the sea, in the midst of their dispute over the sacred waters. They were from the land of Kedesh.
verses.15: And Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying:
verses.16: The LORD, the God of the heavens, will judge everyone person according to their actions.
verses.17: Whoever goes before them, and whoever comes before them, and whoever leads them away, and whoever brings them back – none of these will be considered a “committee” of the LORD, like a sheep that has no shepherd.
verses.18: And the LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun; he will be a leader. Put your hand on him.”
verses.19: And you stood before Elazar the priest and before all the assembly, and you commanded him to do as they said.
verses.20: And You gave it to Him, so that all the tribes of Israel might hear it.
verses.21: And before Eleazar the priest stood, and he asked him regarding the judgment of the lamps before Jehovah. By his direction, they would go out and by his direction they would come in. He and all the sons of Israel, along with all the priests, were present.
verses.22: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded him. He took Joshua and placed him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the elders.
verses.23: And he laid his hands on him, and he commanded him according to what the LORD had said through Moses.
